rulesTestNames: lets managers listen to their own open organizer attention rows
owner: Host Today attention evaluator: hostReadModels attention triggers and sweepOrganizerAttention
read: current organizer managers get and list their own organizer's rows through Firestore listeners
write: server only; the evaluator writes changed rows ahead of time in one transaction per organizer
migrationNotes: The projection stores evaluated provenance, deadlines, destination, and resolution state; executable trigger and permission policy remains versioned in contracts/catalogs/host_attention_policies.json.

A trigger on each of the twelve source collections and a five-minute sweep re-evaluate an organizer from current sources; an evaluation that would read a source over its 400-row cap, write more than 450 rows, or read a source row that fails validation records only the schedule document (overCap or invalidSource) and leaves the rows untouched.
Client-local attendance outbox work is merged in Flutter and Dress Rehearsal is a shortcut, so neither is persisted as a mandatory server attention row.
